verification.build: 37,774 module files, 119 compiled templates, 4,256 public elements

resolutions: Use private definition entries for the internal indicator; owning public families import the definition transitively. Omit internal modules from the consumer manifest, API pages and standalone CDN entries.
Use the verified AndroidX v0_14_0 roles for Standard and Expressive spatial/effects spring parameters. Unit mass maps damping ratio to c=2*zeta*sqrt(stiffness).
The utilitarian selection indicator uses Standard/default spatial motion; this is not a universal scheme setting. Both schemes and all three speeds remain available to internal owners.
Canonical endpoint geometry stays in TanStack Store. Lit Motion SpringControllers own interpolation. Retarget from the painted rectangle and carry velocity through public controller APIs.
Only the owned ripple directive is cancelled; unrelated host motion is independent.
limits: Each actual selection family still needs integrated form/keyboard/appearance verification.
This verifies the selected numerical mapping and observable browser behavior, not pixel/timeline equivalence to an Android runtime.
Final package/React and actual speech-output acceptance remains assigned to M22/M26.
